full_list.title_en: Electron-electron interactions mediated by vibrations: Implications for chirality-induced spin selectivity
full_list.title_zh: 由振动介导的电子-电子相互作用：对手性诱导的自旋选择性的影响
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40990v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Molecular vibrations that modulate both electronic hopping and spin--orbit coupling (SOC) have been proposed as an ingredient of chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS). We study a four-site bridge coupled to a single Peierls mode that modulates both terms, with amplitudes g and χ. An exact Lang--Firsov transformation yields the transformed Hamiltonian in closed form; in the antiadiabatic limit, it reduces to a purely fermionic model with instantaneous vibration-mediated interactions, whose two-body part separates into g², χ², and gχ channels, the last containing a Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI) and correlated hopping. For a common SOC axis, local spin rotations mix these channels, so that the DMI is not separately gauge invariant; the invariant content lies in the components g_parallel and g_perp of the Peierls coupling parallel and perpendicular to the static bond. For spin-independent injection and extraction, the acceptor polarization P_A is odd in both components, vanishes on two nodal lines, and reverses with the handedness of the bridge. We also prove that, for a common SOC axis and a single irreversible exit, a single electron transferred through an empty bridge acquires no long-time polarization, at any coupling strength. Donor--bridge--acceptor simulations with a half-filled bridge and the mode treated explicitly obey the symmetry rule. At weak coupling, P_A scales as g_parallel g_perpsimeq gχ, and, for the transfer rates considered, on-site Coulomb repulsion enhances it by a factor of about three. Within the model, a long-time polarization of the transferred charge is thus a many-electron effect: it requires spin exchange between the transferred electron and the other bridge electrons.
full_list.abstract_zh: 调节电子跳跃和自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的分子振动已被提议作为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的一个组成部分。我们研究了与单个 Peierls 模式耦合的四站点电桥，该模式可调制两项，幅度为 g 和 χ。精确的 Lang-Firsov 变换产生封闭形式的变换后的哈密顿量；在抗绝热极限下，它简化为具有瞬时振动介导的相互作用的纯费米子模型，其二体部分分为 g²、χ² 和 gχ 通道，最后一个包含 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 和相关跳跃。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 调节电子跳跃和自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的分子振动已被提议作为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的一个组成部分。我们研究了与单个 Peierls 模式耦合的四站点电桥，该模式可调制两项，幅度为 g 和 χ。精确的 Lang-Firsov 变换产生封闭形式的变换后的哈密顿量；在抗绝热极限下，它简化为具有瞬时振动介导的相互作用的纯费米子模型，其二体部分分为 g²、χ² 和 gχ 通道，最后一个包含 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 和相关跳跃。对于公共 SOC 轴，局部自旋旋转混合了这些通道，因此 DMI 不是单独的规范不变性；不变的内容在于与静态键平行和垂直的 Peierls 耦合的分量 g_parallel 和 g_perp。对于与自旋无关的注入和提取，受主极化 P_A 在两个分量中都是奇数，在两条节点线上消失，并随着电桥的旋向性而反转。我们还证明，对于共同的 SOC 轴和单个不可逆出口，通过空桥转移的单个电子在任何耦合强度下都不会获得长时间极化。使用半填充桥进行供体-桥-受体模拟，并且所处理的模式明确遵守对称规则。在弱耦合时，P_A 缩放为 g_parallel g_perpsimeq gχ，并且对于所考虑的传输速率，现场库仑斥力将其增强约三倍。在该模型中，转移电荷的长时间极化是一种多电子效应：它需要转移电子和其他桥电子之间的自旋交换。
full_list.summary: 调节电子跳跃和自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的分子振动已被提议作为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的一个组成部分。我们研究了与单个 Peierls 模式耦合的四站点电桥，该模式可调制两项，幅度为 g 和 χ。精确的 Lang-Firsov 变换产生封闭形式的变换后的哈密顿量；在抗绝热极限下，它简化为具有瞬时振动介导的相互作用的纯费米子模型，其二体部分分为 g²、χ² 和 gχ 通道，最后一个包含 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 和相关跳跃。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《由振动介导的电子-电子相互作用：对手性诱导的自旋选择性的影响》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Floquet Engineering of a Quasiequilibrium Superradiant Phase Transition in Landau Polaritons
full_list.title_zh: 朗道极化子中准平衡超辐射相变的 Floquet 工程
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2604.08635v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superradiant phase transitions (SRPTs), characterized by photon condensation and macroscopic matter polarization, are forbidden in equilibrium for homogeneous fields by no-go theorems. Here, we show that Floquet driving can circumvent this constraint in a Landau polariton system consisting of a two-dimensional electron gas coupled to a terahertz cavity in a DC magnetic field. An off-resonant AC magnetic field modulates the cyclotron frequency and light--matter coupling strength while leaving the diamagnetic term unchanged, generating an additional DC coupling contribution. This drives the system across a critical threshold into a superradiant phase, characterized by photon condensation and Landau-level polarization in the ground state of the Floquet Hamiltonian. This quasiequilibrium approach offers a route to SRPTs distinct from driven-dissipative schemes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 超辐射相变（SRPT）以光子凝聚和宏观物质极化为特征，根据 no-go 定理，在均匀场的平衡中是被禁止的。在这里，我们证明了 Floquet 驱动可以在由耦合到直流磁场中太赫兹腔的二维电子气组成的朗道极化子系统中规避这一限制。非共振交流磁场调制回旋加速器频率和光-物质耦合强度，同时保持抗磁项不变，产生额外的直流耦合贡献。这驱动系统跨过临界阈值进入超辐射阶段，其特征是弗洛奎哈密顿量基态下的光子凝聚和朗道级偏振。这种准平衡方法提供了一条不同于驱动耗散方案的 SRPT 途径。

full_list.title_en: Light-Matter Interactions Beyond the Electric Dipole Approximation in Extended Systems Without Multipole Expansion
full_list.title_zh: 在没有多极扩展的扩展系统中超越电偶极近似的光-物质相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.10271v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a general theoretical framework to capture light-matter interactions beyond the electric-dipole approximation, applicable to extended materials interacting with spatially structured electric fields without truncation at finite multipolar order. The approach is based on the Power-Zienau-Woolley (PZW) Hamiltonian for light-matter interactions and a representation of the material Hamiltonian in a basis of maximally localized Wannier functions (MLWFs). We utilize this novel approach to clarify the limitations of the ubiquitous dipole approximation. We consider electric fields with both uniform and non-uniform intensity profiles and a range of ratios of system size to the wavelength of light. We identify the precise conditions under which the dipole approximation breaks down, leading to significant errors in the light-induced dynamics. Contrary to conventional belief, we find that the dipole approximation is robust for uniformly illuminated 1D or 2D materials if light propagates perpendicular to the material. For 3D materials or non-perpendicular illumination, the dipole approximation starts to break down when the wavelength of light becomes comparable to the system size. Furthermore, the dipole approximation fails to capture the light-matter interaction when the material is illuminated partially or non-uniformly. For slowly varying field intensities this failure can be corrected by the finite-order multipolar corrections. However, for fields that vary substantially over the system size, correcting via finite order multipolar terms becomes computationally impractical. In contrast, our approach captures the beyond-dipole light-matter interactions at a computational cost of a standard dipole calculation. This efficiency paves the way for accurate first-principles simulations of spatially-structured light-matter dynamics in nanoscale devices, quantum materials, and interfaces.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个通用的理论框架来捕获超越电偶极近似的光与物质的相互作用，适用于与空间结构电场相互作用的扩展材料，而无需在有限多极阶上截断。该方法基于用于光与物质相互作用的 Power-Zienau-Woolley (PZW) 哈密顿量以及基于最大局域 Wannier 函数 (MLWF) 的材料哈密顿量表示。我们利用这种新颖的方法来阐明普遍存在的偶极子近似的局限性。我们考虑具有均匀和非均匀强度分布的电场以及一系列系统尺寸与光波长的比率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个通用的理论框架来捕获超越电偶极近似的光与物质的相互作用，适用于与空间结构电场相互作用的扩展材料，而无需在有限多极阶上截断。该方法基于用于光与物质相互作用的 Power-Zienau-Woolley (PZW) 哈密顿量以及基于最大局域 Wannier 函数 (MLWF) 的材料哈密顿量表示。我们利用这种新颖的方法来阐明普遍存在的偶极子近似的局限性。我们考虑具有均匀和非均匀强度分布的电场以及一系列系统尺寸与光波长的比率。我们确定了偶极子近似失效的精确条件，从而导致光致动力学产生重大误差。与传统观念相反，我们发现，如果光垂直于材料传播，则偶极近似对于均匀照明的一维或二维材料是稳健的。对于 3D 材料或非垂直照明，当光的波长与系统尺寸相当时，偶极子近似开始失效。此外，当材料被部分或不均匀照亮时，偶极近似无法捕获光与物质的相互作用。对于缓慢变化的场强度，可以通过有限阶多极校正来校正这种故障。然而，对于随系统大小变化很大的场，通过有限阶多极项进行校正在计算上变得不切实际。相比之下，我们的方法以标准偶极子计算的计算成本捕获超偶极子光与物质的相互作用。这种效率为纳米级器件、量子材料和界面中空间结构光物质动力学的精确第一原理模拟铺平了道路。

full_list.title_en: Angular Momentum Hall Effect of Axial Ferrons in Ferroelectrics
full_list.title_zh: 铁电体中轴向铁电子的角动量霍尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32331v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon thermal and angular-momentum (AM) Hall effects are known in non-ferroelectric insulators, yet whether terahertz soft modes of displacive ferroelectrics, i.e., ``ferrons", share them remains open. We report axial ferrons that hold polarization-momentum locking in uniaxial ferroelectrics and show that both effects exist: a longitudinal temperature gradient drives a transverse AM flow without any field, whereas an out-of-plane magnetic field switches on the thermal Hall response. Two competitive channels emerge for the AM Hall effect: self-radiated magnetic fields hybridize two branches into circular modes whose momentum-locked Berry curvature deflects opposite magnetic moments to opposite edges, while temperature-gradient-induced mode quantum coherence adds a magnetic-moment dipole that leads to an opposite transverse AM current. An out-of-plane magnetic field breaks the exact polarization-momentum locking and yields a polarization Hall current. Numerical calculations show these effects are significant in both LiNbO₃ and van der Waals ferroelectrics. Edge magnetization or polarization accumulation can switch adjacent magnets or ferroelectrics, enabling low-power magnetoelectric functionality by thermal current in the future.

full_list.title_en: Anomalous front propagation in many-body quantum transport with memory-dependent resetting
full_list.title_zh: 具有记忆依赖性重置的多体量子传输中的异常前传播
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an exactly solvable framework for non-Markovian quantum many-body dynamics based on stochastic resetting with memory. Applicable to arbitrary time-independent Hamiltonians, including interacting systems, our framework provides an exact representation of the dynamics with memory in terms of the corresponding reset-free evolution, which can be accessed either analytically or numerically. We demonstrate the power of this approach by studying domain-wall melting in a one-dimensional chain of noninteracting fermions, obtaining exact analytical results for the density profile, the local structure of the front edge, the extreme-value statistics of the rightmost fermion, and the integrated current. Remarkably, memory transforms ballistic transport into logarithmically slow propagation without arresting spreading. While the macroscopic density profile retains its original scaling function, the front edge broadens as sqrtln t rather than t¹/³ at late times and develops a qualitatively different edge structure. Furthermore, the extreme-value statistics change from Tracy--Widom to Gaussian, while both the mean and variance of the integrated current grow logarithmically in time. Our predictions are in excellent agreement with numerical simulations. These results reveal how memory can fundamentally alter quantum many-body transport and its fluctuations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种基于记忆随机重置的非马尔可夫量子多体动力学的精确可解框架。我们的框架适用于任意时间无关的哈密顿量，包括相互作用的系统，根据相应的无重置演化提供了记忆动力学的精确表示，可以通过分析或数值方式访问。我们通过研究非相互作用费米子一维链中的畴壁熔化，获得密度分布、前沿局部结构、最右边费米子的极值统计和积分电流的精确分析结果，展示了这种方法的威力。值得注意的是，记忆将弹道传输转变为对数缓慢的传播，而不会阻止传播。

full_list.title_en: Antiferroelectric Fluids with Hierarchical Polar Organization
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Antiferroelectric Fluids with Hierarchical Polar Organization
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of the ferroelectric nematic (NF) phase has accelerated research on fluids exhibiting polar order along the molecular long axis. However, their antiferroelectric (AFE) counterparts remain less explored. Here, we investigate how terminal alkyl-chain elongation competes with polar core-core interactions in a homologous series. This series exhibits modulated AFE order accompanied by SmC-type cybotactic correlations, with the AFE phase persisting in homologs bearing terminal alkyl chains of up to 17 carbon atoms. Three distinct phase sequences on cooling lead to two types of two-dimensional (2D) AFE lattices. Multiple sharp X-ray diffraction (XRD) peaks reveal rectangular and oblique lattice structures, supporting their classification as AFE columnar phases. XRD analysis and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations support a hierarchical structural model in which locally aligned polar molecules occupy thin segments of finite width within polar columns. The columns occupy the sites of a 2D lattice, with neighboring columns polarized in opposite directions. This model provides a structural framework for understanding the distinct precursor phase sequences and links packing between columns to the resulting AFE superstructures.

full_list.title_en: Antiferromagnetic phase of MnTe2: spin-order-induced renormalization of phonon Raman spectrum
full_list.title_zh: MnTe2 的反铁磁相：自旋序诱导的声子拉曼光谱重正化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, two modes of spin wave excitations (magnons) were detected in Raman scattering spectra of MnTe2. It is an unconventional magnet that features a pyrite-type crystal structure hosting a non-collinear, non-coplanar antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin order below the Néel temperature. In this brief communication, the focus is primarily on the effect of spin ordering on lattice dynamics (phonons) that has been established through temperature (5 - 300 K), linear polarization angle (0 deg - 360 deg) and external magnetic field (up to 16 T) dependent measurements. It has been found that below the magnetic transition temperature, the frequencies of four out of five Raman-active lattice vibrations (i.e., Eg and three Tg phonon modes) revealed significant departure from the mechanism of the three-phonon anharmonic decay described by Klemens model. Here, we propose a new model considering spin-phonon coupling to explain frequency renormalization of the phonon part of the Raman spectrum upon the para-/antiferro- (PM/AFM) magnetic phase transition change in MnTe2. Through employing Green's function formalism, we show that a simple two-sublattice collinear antiferromagnet approach follows well both spin ordering induced hardening and softening of phonon modes observed in AFM phase of MnTe2 upon cooling. Additionally, the detailed temperature and field dependences of the energy for both magnon modes are presented. In addition to unexpected twofold anisotropy of the higher energy magnon mode (approx. 3.5 meV) unveiled in crossed configuration, our magneto-optical measurements revealed a subtle, yet definite softening trend for the lower energy mode (approx. 2.6 meV). Although the precise reasons for these effects remain unclear, we put forward a symmetry reduction in the local atomic surroundings as a possible mechanism for discussion.
full_list.abstract_zh: 最近，在 MnTe2 的拉曼散射光谱中检测到两种模式的自旋波激发（磁振子）。它是一种非常规磁体，具有黄铁矿型晶体结构，在尼尔温度以下具有非共线、非共面反铁磁 (AFM) 自旋序。在这篇简短的交流中，重点主要是自旋排序对晶格动力学（声子）的影响，该影响是通过温度（5 - 300 K）、线性偏振角（0 度 - 360 度）和外部磁场（高达 16 T）相关测量建立的。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 最近，在 MnTe2 的拉曼散射光谱中检测到两种模式的自旋波激发（磁振子）。它是一种非常规磁体，具有黄铁矿型晶体结构，在尼尔温度以下具有非共线、非共面反铁磁 (AFM) 自旋序。在这篇简短的交流中，重点主要是自旋排序对晶格动力学（声子）的影响，该影响是通过温度（5 - 300 K）、线性偏振角（0 度 - 360 度）和外部磁场（高达 16 T）相关测量建立的。研究发现，在磁转变温度以下，五分之四的拉曼活性晶格振动（即 Eg 和三个 Tg 声子模式）的频率与克莱门斯模型描述的三声子非谐衰变机制显着背离。在这里，我们提出了一种考虑自旋声子耦合的新模型，以解释拉曼光谱声子部分在 MnTe2 中对/反铁（PM/AFM）磁相变变化时的频率重整化。通过采用格林函数形式，我们证明了一种简单的双亚晶格共线反铁磁体方法很好地遵循了冷却时在 MnTe2 AFM 相中观察到的自旋排序引起的声子模式的硬化和软化。此外，还介绍了两种磁振子模式能量的详细温度和场依赖性。除了交叉配置中揭示的高能磁振子模式（约 3.5 meV）出人意料的双重各向异性之外，我们的磁光测量还揭示了低能模式（约 2.6 meV）的微妙但明确的软化趋势。尽管这些效应的确切原因尚不清楚，但我们提出局部原子环境的对称性降低作为讨论的可能机制。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《MnTe2 的反铁磁相：自旋序诱导的声子拉曼光谱重正化》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Classification of spin space groups and crystal magnetic orders
full_list.title_zh: 自旋空间群和晶体磁序的分类
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin space groups (SSGs) describe magnetic crystals in the limit of negligible spin-orbit coupling, where spatial and spin rotations decouple. Although algebraic enumerations of SSGs exist, their abstract mathematical approaches obscure the physical meaning of the resulting classifications, leaving the direct correspondence between SSGs and real-space magnetic orders unestablished. Here, we present a physically motivated framework for enumerating and classifying SSGs based on their translation holonomy---the image of the spatial lattice translation group under the spin homomorphism. The three classes of abelian images in SO(3) divide SSGs into three basic translation types. Translation holonomy constrains the spin operations associated with point-group elements, yielding a complete enumeration of SSGs organized by a physical hierarchy. Within this framework, translation holonomy classifies SSGs and magnetic orders into 17 universal spin-lattice types, each with unambiguous Bragg-peak geometries and polarization signatures in neutron diffraction. Beyond organizing known magnetic orders, this framework directly predicts four universal physical phenomena: (i) exact magnetization compensation enforced by certain spin-lattice types; (ii) an exact group-theoretic criterion for the emergence of noncommuting Brillouin zones; (iii) a new type of 3Q magnetic order with vanishing octupoles; and (iv) the realization of strictly collinear momentum-space spin textures protected by reflection-staggered coplanar spin lattices. We also construct a spin space group database organized according to this physical hierarchy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋空间群（SSG）描述了可忽略的自旋轨道耦合极限下的磁性晶体，其中空间和自旋旋转解耦。尽管存在 SSG 的代数枚举，但它们的抽象数学方法模糊了所得分类的物理意义，导致 SSG 与真实空间磁序之间的直接对应关系尚未建立。在这里，我们提出了一个基于物理驱动的框架，用于根据平移完整性（自旋同态下的空间晶格平移群的图像）对 SSG 进行枚举和分类。 SO(3) 中的三类阿贝尔图像将 SSG 分为三种基本翻译类型。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 自旋空间群（SSG）描述了可忽略的自旋轨道耦合极限下的磁性晶体，其中空间和自旋旋转解耦。尽管存在 SSG 的代数枚举，但它们的抽象数学方法模糊了所得分类的物理意义，导致 SSG 与真实空间磁序之间的直接对应关系尚未建立。在这里，我们提出了一个基于物理驱动的框架，用于根据平移完整性（自旋同态下的空间晶格平移群的图像）对 SSG 进行枚举和分类。 SO(3) 中的三类阿贝尔图像将 SSG 分为三种基本翻译类型。平移完整约束与点群元素相关的自旋运算，产生由物理层次结构组织的 SSG 的完整枚举。在此框架内，平移完整学将 SSG 和磁序分为 17 种通用自旋晶格类型，每种类型都具有明确的布拉格峰几何形状和中子衍射中的偏振特征。除了组织已知的磁序之外，该框架还直接预测了四种普遍的物理现象：（i）由某些自旋晶格类型强制执行的精确磁化补偿； (ii) 非通勤布里渊区出现的精确群论标准； (iii) 一种新型的消失八极子 3Q 磁序； (iv) 实现由反射交错共面自旋晶格保护的严格共线动量空间自旋纹理。我们还构建了一个根据该物理层次结构组织的自旋空间群数据库。

full_list.title_en: Compositionally Tunable Synthesis of High-Entropy Transition Metal Dichalcogenides Exhibiting Above-Room-Temperature Magnetism
full_list.title_zh: 具有高于室温磁性的高熵过渡金属二硫属化物的成分可调合成
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.33115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As silicon-based electronics approach their physical limits, low-dimensional magnetic materials have attracted increasing attention for next-generation electronic and information technologies. Realizing these opportunities requires two-dimensional (2D) materials with robust and tunable room-temperature magnetism. Here, we report a two-step synthesis strategy for fabricating 2D high-entropy transition metal dichalcogenides (HE-TMDs) incorporating magnetic elements beyond conventional groups 4-6. High-entropy layered double hydroxides (HE-LDHs) are first synthesized via hydrothermal coprecipitation, enabling atomic-level mixing of diverse transition metals across groups 4-12. Subsequent chalcogenization yields 2D HE-TMDs while preserving homogeneous elemental distribution. This approach circumvents the constraints of solid-state reaction, chemical vapor transport methods, enabling the synthesis of compositionally complex and structurally controlled 2D magnets. Representative (VCrFeCoNi)S2-x exhibits robust magnetism above room temperature, demonstrating the potential of this high-entropy design strategy for expanding the compositional and functional diversity of 2D magnetic materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 随着硅基电子产品接近其物理极限，低维磁性材料越来越受到下一代电子和信息技术的关注。实现这些机会需要具有强大且可调节室温磁性的二维 (2D) 材料。在这里，我们报告了一种两步合成策略，用于制造二维高熵过渡金属二硫属化物（HE-TMD），其中包含超出常规第 4-6 族的磁性元素。首先通过水热共沉淀合成高熵层状双氢氧化物 (HE-LDH)，从而实现 4-12 族不同过渡金属的原子级混合。随后的硫属化产生 2D HE-TMD，同时保持均匀的元素分布。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 随着硅基电子产品接近其物理极限，低维磁性材料越来越受到下一代电子和信息技术的关注。实现这些机会需要具有强大且可调节室温磁性的二维 (2D) 材料。在这里，我们报告了一种两步合成策略，用于制造二维高熵过渡金属二硫属化物（HE-TMD），其中包含超出常规第 4-6 族的磁性元素。首先通过水热共沉淀合成高熵层状双氢氧化物 (HE-LDH)，从而实现 4-12 族不同过渡金属的原子级混合。随后的硫属化产生 2D HE-TMD，同时保持均匀的元素分布。这种方法规避了固态反应、化学气相传输方法的限制，能够合成成分复杂且结构受控的二维磁体。代表性的 (VCrFeCoNi)S2-x 在室温以上表现出强大的磁性，证明了这种高熵设计策略在扩大二维磁性材料的成分和功能多样性方面的潜力。

full_list.title_en: Electrons in a hard-wall cylinder with helicoidal metric: time-reversal pairing, cubic anticrossings, and twist-activated dipole transitions
full_list.title_zh: 具有螺旋度量的硬壁圆柱体中的电子：时间反转配对、立方反交叉和扭转激活偶极子跃迁
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the scalar Schrödinger equation in a helicoidal metric when the axial direction is closed by Dirichlet walls built into the operator domain. With hard walls, the axial derivative cannot be replaced by a traveling-wave factor, and in a rotationally symmetric spinless cavity, time reversal makes the levels with azimuthal numbers m and -m exactly degenerate. We write the Hamiltonian as a Hermitian coupled-subband matrix and give an exact gauge-adapted variational representation. For a finite radius, the leading twist correction is quadratic, and changes sign at a critical aspect ratio; for an unbounded radial domain, it is linear in |Ω_g|. Retuning the aspect ratio through an isolated radial--axial resonance within one m sector opens an avoided crossing with gap Δgₐₚ/E_R=1.648775ldots|Ω_gR²/L|³ to leading order. A transverse dipole transition forbidden without twist acquires an oscillator strength quadratic in the twist, with leading coefficient 0.0559408010 for R/L=2 from perturbation theory. Dipole sum rules and the convergence of the currents serve as checks on the numerics. We also give the inverse-mass tensor required for a scalar realization and re-examine each statement and figure of the earlier article [Opt. Quantum Electron. 58, 113 (2026)] within the corrected model.
full_list.abstract_zh: 当轴向方向被算子域中内置的狄利克雷壁封闭时，我们研究螺旋度量中的标量薛定谔方程。对于硬壁，轴向导数不能用行波因子代替，并且在旋转对称的无旋转腔中，时间反转使得方位角数为 m 和 -m 的能级精确退化。我们将哈密顿量写为埃尔米特耦合子带矩阵，并给出精确的规范自适应变分表示。对于有限半径，主扭曲校正是二次的，并且在临界纵横比处改变符号；对于无界径向域，它在 |Ω_g| 中呈线性。

full_list.title_en: Localization in one-dimensional magnetic quasicrystals
full_list.title_zh: 一维磁性准晶的局域化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The celebrated Aubry-André-Harper model undergoes a metal-insulator transition akin to Anderson localization due to an energetic competition between nearest-neighbor hopping and a quasiperiodic on-site potential. In this work, we consider the problem of a one-dimensional lattice subject to a quasiperiodic external field, where the topology of the underlying graph mediates the competition between insulating and conducting phases. In particular, we present examples for which all dispersive eigenstates are critically localized, as well as models in which they are exponentially localized. We also demonstrate the coexistence of these phenomena with an extensive set of degenerate finitely supported eigenstates forming a flat band. Finally, we construct models with exactly solvable mobility edges arising only from graph structure. Going beyond these single-particle results, we show---using exact-diagonalization calculations of the bosonic dynamics---that, as in the conventional Aubry-André-Harper case, on-site interactions drive localized eigenstates toward extendedness. Our results provide a framework for exploring how magnetic interference and interactions jointly constrain transport in quasiperiodic lattices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 由于最近邻跳跃和准周期现场势之间的激烈竞争，著名的奥布里-安德烈-哈珀模型经历了类似于安德森局域化的金属-绝缘体转变。在这项工作中，我们考虑了受准周期外场影响的一维晶格问题，其中底层图的拓扑介导了绝缘相和导电相之间的竞争。特别是，我们提出了所有色散本征态都临界局域化的示例，以及它们指数局域化的模型。我们还证明了这些现象与形成平带的大量简并有限支撑本征态的共存。最后，我们构建具有仅由图结构产生的完全可解的移动边的模型。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 由于最近邻跳跃和准周期现场势之间的激烈竞争，著名的奥布里-安德烈-哈珀模型经历了类似于安德森局域化的金属-绝缘体转变。在这项工作中，我们考虑了受准周期外场影响的一维晶格问题，其中底层图的拓扑介导了绝缘相和导电相之间的竞争。特别是，我们提出了所有色散本征态都临界局域化的示例，以及它们指数局域化的模型。我们还证明了这些现象与形成平带的大量简并有限支撑本征态的共存。最后，我们构建具有仅由图结构产生的完全可解的移动边的模型。除了这些单粒子结果之外，我们使用玻色子动力学的精确对角化计算表明，与传统的奥布里-安德烈-哈珀案例一样，现场相互作用驱动局域本征态走向扩展。我们的结果为探索磁干扰和相互作用如何共同约束准周期晶格中的输运提供了一个框架。

full_list.title_en: Magnetoelectric response to a Néel domain wall in spin-orbit coupled superconducting films: Spontaneous currents, vortex pinning, and vortex-antivortex nucleation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Magnetoelectric response to a Néel domain wall in spin-orbit coupled superconducting films: Spontaneous currents, vortex pinning, and vortex-antivortex nucleation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32379v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the superconducting response induced by a Néel domain wall in a thin superconducting film proximity-coupled to a ferromagnetic layer in the presence of interfacial Rashba spin-orbit coupling. The combined action of the magnetic texture and broken inversion symmetry generates a magnetoelectric coupling that induces spontaneous equilibrium currents. To establish the basic response to a continuously rotating magnetic texture, we first consider a periodic harmonic cycloid as an analytically tractable reference problem. Near Tc, this reference problem illustrates how the magnetoelectric coupling modifies the superconducting order parameter, while below Tc it provides a simple setting for describing the phase response, Pearl screening, and the interaction with a vortex. We then turn to the main problem of this work, a single Néel domain wall, and derive analytical expressions for its equilibrium phase profile, spontaneous current, magnetic field, and vortex-wall interaction energy.We show that the Néel wall acts as an extended magnetoelectric source and produces a vorticity-selective pinning landscape controlled by the competition between the wall width and the effective screening length. We further demonstrate that sufficiently strong magnetoelectric coupling can render a bound vortex-antivortex pair energetically favorable relative to the vortex-free state, even in the absence of an applied magnetic field. Our results provide an analytical framework for understanding magnetoelectric vortex pinning and vortex-antivortex nucleation by Néel domain walls in spin-orbit coupled superconducting films.

full_list.title_en: Nonreciprocal state-selective splitting of eigenstates at a polarization exceptional point
full_list.title_zh: 极化异常点处本征态的非互易态选择性分裂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Hermitian photonic systems can be engineered to exhibit exceptional points (EPs), where eigenvalues and eigenstates coalesce. Although perturbations near EPs have mainly been characterized through eigenvalue splitting, the branch-resolved evolution of the coalesced eigenstates under a tunable reciprocity-breaking perturbation remains less systematically explored. Here, we show that tunable nonreciprocal coupling can produce state-selective splitting of the coalesced eigenstates near a second-order polarization EP. Using temporal coupled-mode theory, we find that the corresponding off-diagonal perturbation produces a triangular Hamiltonian in the circular-polarization basis. In the ideal limit, one eigenstate remains pinned to the EP state, whereas the other is continuously reoriented by the perturbation. In a realistic scattering system, residual reverse-polarization conversion weakly displaces the nominally pinned branch, resulting in quasi-pinning. We numerically demonstrate this mechanism in a reflective magneto-optical metasurface supporting a circular-polarization EP of the reflection matrix near 582 nm. Full-wave simulations show that a perpendicular magneto-optical bias leaves one reflection eigenstate close to the EP state while reversibly displacing the other on the Poincare sphere. This asymmetric eigenstate evolution manifests as a magnetically tunable circular-dichroic reflection response. Our results establish a nonreciprocal route to state-selective eigenstate control near polarization EPs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 非厄米光子系统可以设计为表现出特异点（EP），即特征值和特征态合并的地方。尽管EP附近的扰动主要通过特征值分裂来表征，但在可调谐互易破坏扰动下合并本征态的分支解析演化仍然很少被系统地探索。在这里，我们证明可调谐的不可逆耦合可以在二阶偏振 EP 附近产生合并本征态的状态选择性分裂。使用时间耦合模式理论，我们发现相应的非对角扰动在圆偏振基础上产生三角哈密顿量。在理想极限下，一种本征态保持固定在 EP 态，而另一种则通过扰动不断重新定向。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 非厄米光子系统可以设计为表现出特异点（EP），即特征值和特征态合并的地方。尽管EP附近的扰动主要通过特征值分裂来表征，但在可调谐互易破坏扰动下合并本征态的分支解析演化仍然很少被系统地探索。在这里，我们证明可调谐的不可逆耦合可以在二阶偏振 EP 附近产生合并本征态的状态选择性分裂。使用时间耦合模式理论，我们发现相应的非对角扰动在圆偏振基础上产生三角哈密顿量。在理想极限下，一种本征态保持固定在 EP 态，而另一种则通过扰动不断重新定向。在现实的散射系统中，残余反向偏振转换微弱地取代了名义上钉扎的分支，从而导致准钉扎。我们在支持 582 nm 附近反射矩阵圆偏振 EP 的反射磁光超表面中以数值方式演示了这种机制。全波模拟表明，垂直磁光偏置使一个反射本征态接近 EP 态，同时在庞加莱球上可逆地取代另一个。这种不对称本征态演化表现为磁可调圆二向色反射响应。我们的结果建立了一种在极化 EP 附近进行状态选择性本征态控制的非互易途径。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Origin of quadrupolar order in the 5d¹ double perovskite Ba₂MgReO₆
full_list.title_zh: 5d1 双钙钛矿 Ba2MgReO₆ 中四极有序的起源
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite extensive experimental and theoretical studies of quadrupolar order in Ba₂MgReO₆, the microscopic origin and relative energy scales of the interactions driving it remain unresolved. In particular, the observed ferroic ordering of the z² quadrupole has remained difficult to explain, as the relative contributions of superexchange, classical quadrupole-quadrupole interactions, vibronic couplings, and virtual excitations to higher-energy levels have not been established quantitatively. Here, we determine all these interactions from first principles and solve the resulting microscopic Hamiltonian. The calculated ground state reproduces the experimentally observed quadrupolar order parameters and the associated structural distortions with quantitative accuracy. Disentangling the individual contributions, we find that ferroic z² order originates from a linear-quartic coupling, generated by virtual excitations to the Jₑff= 1/2 doublet and driven by vibronic interactions. Our results establish the hierarchy of microscopic interactions underlying quadrupolar order in Ba₂MgReO₆ and provide a unified ab  initio description of its coupled electronic and lattice degrees of freedom.
full_list.abstract_zh: 尽管对 Ba MgReO 中的四极有序进行了广泛的实验和理论研究，但驱动其相互作用的微观起源和相对能量尺度仍未解决。特别是，观察到的 z² 四极杆的铁序仍然难以解释，因为超交换、经典四极杆-四极杆相互作用、振动耦合和对更高能级的虚拟激发的相对贡献尚未定量确定。在这里，我们根据第一原理确定所有这些相互作用，并求解所得的微观哈密顿量。计算的基态以定量精度再现了实验观察到的四极有序参数和相关的结构畸变。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 尽管对 Ba MgReO 中的四极有序进行了广泛的实验和理论研究，但驱动其相互作用的微观起源和相对能量尺度仍未解决。特别是，观察到的 z² 四极杆的铁序仍然难以解释，因为超交换、经典四极杆-四极杆相互作用、振动耦合和对更高能级的虚拟激发的相对贡献尚未定量确定。在这里，我们根据第一原理确定所有这些相互作用，并求解所得的微观哈密顿量。计算的基态以定量精度再现了实验观察到的四极有序参数和相关的结构畸变。理清各个贡献，我们发现铁质 z2 阶源自线性四次耦合，由 Jₑff= 1/2 双峰的虚拟激励产生并由振动相互作用驱动。我们的结果建立了 Ba MgReO 中四极有序的微观相互作用的层次结构，并提供了其耦合电子和晶格自由度的统一从头开始描述。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Reversible Self-Assembly of a P-Ir(100)-P Trilayer on Ir(111)
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Reversible Self-Assembly of a P-Ir(100)-P Trilayer on Ir(111)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adsorbate-induced surface reconstructions offer a route to engineer low-dimensional materials with atomic arrangements and electronic properties fundamentally different from those of their parent substrates. Here, we demonstrate how phosphorus adsorption on Ir(111) drives the formation of an incommensurate P-Ir-P trilayer, in which a square Ir(100)-like atomic lattice emerges from the underlying hexagonal crystal. This transformation illustrates how strong adsorbate-substrate interactions can stabilize unconventional atomic coordination within an ultrathin metallic structure. Remarkably, the process is reversible, allowing the system to switch between distinct structural phases through phosphorus deposition and thermal annealing. The resulting trilayer exhibits a two-dimensional, semimetal-like electronic structure dominated by Ir 5d states. Our findings establish adsorbate-driven symmetry transformation as a strategy for engineering atomically thin transition-metal compounds with structural and electronic properties inaccessible through conventional surface growth.

full_list.title_en: Spin Current Generation Controlled by the Néel State in a Compensated Ferrimagnet
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Spin Current Generation Controlled by the Néel State in a Compensated Ferrimagnet
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.05618v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Compensated ferrimagnets, which break sublattice and time-reversal symmetries in the ground state, exhibit an isotropic ferromagnet-like spin splitting despite a vanishing net magnetization, in contrast to altermagnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting. We investigate how isotropic spin splitting manifests in spin transport by analyzing the spin Seebeck effect and spin pumping in a junction between a compensated ferrimagnet and a normal metal. We show that compensated ferrimagnets generate a sizable spin Seebeck signal, with a sign that can be reversed by switching between the two Néel states. Furthermore, we demonstrate that spin pumping exhibits a Néel-state-dependent resonance splitting, which is absent in conventional antiferromagnets. These results identify spin pumping as a natural readout mechanism for compensated ferrimagnets and establish them as promising magnetization-free building blocks for spintronic memory devices.

full_list.title_en: Spin-adapted state preparation for quantum chemistry
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Spin-adapted state preparation for quantum chemistry
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30014v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum phase estimation for strongly-correlated molecules requires an initial state of high overlap with the true ground state, and preparing one is a significant fault-tolerant cost. Matrix product states (MPS) produced by the density matrix renormalisation group (DMRG) are a leading choice, yet existing circuits treat their tensors as dense or do not use the full symmetries present in molecular electronic Hamiltonians. In quantum chemistry, DMRG also exploits total spin, a non-abelian symmetry, storing one amplitude per spin multiplet instead of one per state. We show that the reduced tensors of such a spin-adapted MPS, labelled by the steps of the unitary group approach, form an abelian-symmetric MPS, which existing block-sparse preparation protocols can load at a cost set by the multiplet count. One state-independent rotation per site, determined by a Clebsch-Gordan coefficient, then returns the state to the occupation basis. We provide resource estimates for our circuits on singlet ground states of active space models of iron-sulphur clusters, finding improvements in Toffoli count up to 135× compared to dense methods and 4.9× compared to block-sparse methods applied to the same states, with up to 3.7× fewer ancilla qubits required.

full_list.title_en: Spin-Group versus Magnetic-Group Selection Rules for Nonlinear Photocurrents in Compensated Ferrimagnets
full_list.title_zh: 补偿亚铁磁体中非线性光电流的自旋群与磁群选择规则
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical excitation offers a contact-free, ultrafast route to charge and spin currents, with symmetry determining which nonlinear photocurrents are allowed and whether they carry charge, spin, or both. Spin-group symmetry describes the limit without spin-orbit coupling (SOC), whereas magnetic-group symmetry accounts for SOC. We show that the two descriptions yield different selection rules for both charge and spin photocurrents in the multiferroic compensated ferrimagnet GaFeO₃. Without SOC, only linear shift and circular injection currents are allowed, with identical components for charge and spin, so every charge current is spin polarized along the moments. SOC leaves these charge currents nearly unchanged, activates magnetic linear injection and circular shift charge currents, and enables pure spin currents polarized perpendicular to the moments. Ferroelectric switching reverses the linear shift and circular injection charge currents and their spin polarization. These findings establish the importance of magnetic-group symmetry for a complete description of nonlinear charge and spin photocurrents in compensated ferrimagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 光激发提供了一种无接触、超快的电荷和自旋电流路径，其对称性决定了允许哪些非线性光电流以及它们是否携带电荷、自旋或两者。自旋群对称性描述了没有自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 的极限，而磁群对称性则说明了 SOC。我们表明，这两种描述对多铁补偿亚铁磁体 GaFeO₃ 中的电荷和自旋光电流产生不同的选择规则。如果没有 SOC，则仅允许线性移位和循环注入电流，充电和自旋具有相同的分量，因此每个充电电流都会沿时刻自旋极化。

full_list.title_en: Strain-enabled dynamical magnetoelectric coupling in BaFe₁₂O₁₉
full_list.title_zh: BaFe₁₂O₁₉ 中的应变驱动动态磁电耦合
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical excitation has emerged as a powerful tool for manipulating and creating non-equilibrium phases of matter. Yet, the pathways available for optical control are intrinsically limited by the symmetries and interactions of the equilibrium system. Here, we demonstrate that these pathways can be redesigned through atomic-structural engineering to access hidden dynamical properties. By combining resonant vibrational excitation with epitaxial strain, we realize a light-induced, room-temperature multiferroic state in strained thin films of the technologically relevant hexagonal ferrimagnet, barium hexaferrite (BaFe₁₂O₁₉, BaM). Time-resolved second harmonic generation and magneto-optical Kerr effect measurements reveal an enhanced ferroelectric polarization together with a weakening of the magnetic moment upon exciting mid-infrared phonons in strained BaM thin films, but not in the bulk material. Structural analysis and first-principles-based theory show that this effect is enabled by strain-generated displacement of Fe³⁺ ions, which break the local symmetry and facilitate an emergent dynamical magnetoelectric coupling. Both the strong lattice excitation and strain-induced symmetry breaking are essential for enabling this dynamical coupling, promising an important template for designing otherwise inaccessible non-equilibrium phenomena.
full_list.abstract_zh: 光激发已成为操纵和创建物质非平衡相的强大工具。然而，可用于光学控制的途径本质上受到平衡系统的对称性和相互作用的限制。在这里，我们证明这些途径可以通过原子结构工程重新设计，以获取隐藏的动力学特性。通过将谐振振动激发与外延应变相结合，我们在技术相关的六方铁磁体、六方铁氧体钡（BaFe₁2O₁₉，BaM）的应变薄膜中实现了光诱导的室温多铁态。时间分辨二次谐波产生和磁光克尔效应测量表明，在应变 BaM 薄膜中激发中红外声子时，铁电极化增强，磁矩减弱，但在块体材料中则不然。

full_list.title_en: Zone-folded Goldstone mode of the field-induced spin supersolid in the square-lattice S=1 antiferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 方晶格 S=1 反铁磁体中场致自旋超固体的区域折叠戈德斯通模式
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The field-induced spin supersolid of the square-lattice S=1 antiferromagnet with single-ion and exchange anisotropy has so far been characterized only by static observables, among them a two-peak transverse structure factor. We compute its dynamic spin structure factors, and those of the neighboring phases, by stochastic analytic continuation of stochastic-series-expansion quantum Monte Carlo data on a 16×16 lattice at inverse temperature β=32, at one field in each of the supersolid, the m_z=1/2 Ising plateau and the canted XY phase. The supersolid has a single Goldstone mode, which the checkerboard folds onto both the ordering wave vector Q=(π,π) and q=(0,0), so that it appears in both spin channels at both points with one velocity v=1.36±0.01. The canted phase shows half of this pattern and the plateau none, the latter carrying instead a gapped magnon band and a two-magnon longitudinal continuum. Exactly at Q and (0,0) the finite-lattice spectra are governed by a rotor tower of the condensate in the transverse channel and an Ising doublet of the checkerboard in the longitudinal one, both present at Q in the supersolid. Three parameter-free comparisons with the stiffness and the uniform susceptibility of the same runs, for the velocity, the sound-mode weight and the thermal decay of the rotor tower, tie the continued spectra to raw Monte Carlo observables. The folded Goldstone mode is the dynamical fingerprint of the supersolid.
full_list.abstract_zh: 具有单离子和交换各向异性的方晶格 S=1 反铁磁体的场致自旋超固体迄今为止仅通过静态可观测量来表征，其中包括双峰横向结构因子。我们通过在反温度 β=32 的 16×16 晶格上，在超固体、m_z=1/2 伊辛平台和倾斜 XY 相的每个场中，对 16×16 晶格上的随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗数据进行随机解析延拓，计算其动态自旋结构因子以及邻近相的动态自旋结构因子。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 具有单离子和交换各向异性的方晶格 S=1 反铁磁体的场致自旋超固体迄今为止仅通过静态可观测量来表征，其中包括双峰横向结构因子。我们通过在反温度 β=32 的 16×16 晶格上，在超固体、m_z=1/2 伊辛平台和倾斜 XY 相的每个场中，对 16×16 晶格上的随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗数据进行随机解析延拓，计算其动态自旋结构因子以及邻近相的动态自旋结构因子。超固体具有单一戈德斯通模式，棋盘折叠到有序波矢量 Q=(π,π) 和 q=(0,0) 上，因此它以一个速度 v=1.36±0.01 出现在两个点的两个自旋通道中。倾斜相位显示了该图案的一半，而平台则没有，后者携带有间隙的磁振子带和两个磁振子纵向连续体。恰好在 Q 和 (0,0) 处，有限晶格谱由横向通道中凝结物的转子塔和纵向通道中棋盘的伊辛双峰控制，两者都存在于超固体中的 Q 处。对于相同运行的速度、声模重量和转子塔的热衰减，对刚度和均匀磁化率进行了三个无参数比较，将连续光谱与原始蒙特卡罗可观测值联系起来。折叠戈德斯通模式是超固体的动力学指纹。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Circular phonon dichroism in d-wave altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: d波交错磁体中的圆声子二向色性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.21221v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets, a new class of collinear antiferromagnets, exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting and offer compelling advantages for antiferromagnetic spintronics. However, the magnetic order is intrinsically difficult to read out, which hinders practical applications. We propose finite-momentum circular phonon dichroism as a direct probe that distinguishes the two opposite out-of-plane Néel vector configurations in two-dimensional d-wave altermagnets. Combining Onsager reciprocity with C₂z lattice symmetry, we find that the dichroic signal reverses sign when the Néel vector is flipped for the in-plane phonon wave vectors. Moreover, a channel-resolved decomposition identifies the circular phonon dichroism originates from the interband coherent transitions. Representative finite-momentum cuts show pronounced dichroic asymmetric ratio, with |ηCPD|=36%. Our work reveals that the circular-ultrasound absorption can distinguish the two opposite out-of-plane Néel vector configurations of d-wave altermagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 可变磁体是一类新型的共线反铁磁体，表现出与动量相关的自旋劈裂，为反铁磁自旋电子学提供了引人注目的优势。然而，磁序本质上难以读出，这阻碍了其实际应用。我们提出有限动量圆声子二向色性作为一种直接探测方法，用于区分二维d波交错磁体中两个相反的平面外奈尔矢量构型。将昂萨格倒易关系与C₂z晶格对称性相结合，我们发现，当平面声子波矢量的奈尔矢量翻转时，二向色性信号的符号发生反转。此外，通道分辨分解表明，圆偏振声子二向性源自带间相干跃迁。

full_list.title_en: Inner sublattice competition: a minimal mechanism for reentrant localizations in Aubry-André lattice
full_list.title_zh: 内亚晶格竞争：Aubry-André 晶格中可重入定位的最小机制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.24720v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We construct a double mosaic Aubry-André (DMAA) model with two independent quasiperiodic potentials assigned to corresponding even and odd sublattices of the AA lattice, and show that the competition between them gives rise to multiple localization-delocalization transitions under single-parameter tuning. Such reentrant localizations are verified by comprehensive numerical characterizations including the inverse participation ratio, normalized participation ratio, fractal dimension, and real-space wavefunction distributions. Simulations based on a continuous polariton model yield consistent results, confirming the experimental feasibility of the predicted phenomena. This inner sublattice competition mechanism works in a minimal way for reentrant localizations without additional ingredients or dynamical modifications such as long-range hopping, mixed quasiperiodic and random disorder, or non-Hermitian gain and loss, offering a concise route to engineer reentrant localization based on the canonical AA lattice family.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个双马赛克 Aubry-André (DMAA) 模型，将两个独立的准周期势分配给 AA 晶格的相应偶数和奇数子晶格，并表明它们之间的竞争在单参数调整下引起了多个局域-离域转变。这种重入定位通过全面的数值表征进行了验证，包括逆参与比、归一化参与比、分形维数和实空间波函数分布。基于连续极化子模型的模拟产生了一致的结果，证实了预测现象的实验可行性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一个双马赛克 Aubry-André (DMAA) 模型，将两个独立的准周期势分配给 AA 晶格的相应偶数和奇数子晶格，并表明它们之间的竞争在单参数调整下引起了多个局域-离域转变。这种重入定位通过全面的数值表征进行了验证，包括逆参与比、归一化参与比、分形维数和实空间波函数分布。基于连续极化子模型的模拟产生了一致的结果，证实了预测现象的实验可行性。这种内部子晶格竞争机制以最小的方式实现可重入定位，无需额外的成分或动态修改，例如长程跳跃、混合准周期和随机无序或非厄米增益和损失，为基于规范 AA 晶格族的工程可重入定位提供了一条简洁的途径。

full_list.title_en: Coexisting positive and negative ionospheric storms and large-scale traveling ionospheric disturbances over China during the October 2024 geomagnetic storm
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Coexisting positive and negative ionospheric storms and large-scale traveling ionospheric disturbances over China during the October 2024 geomagnetic storm
full_list.abstract: This study combines ground-based GNSS observations, satellite measurements, geomagnetic data, and TIE-GCM simulations to investigate the evolution and driving mechanisms of positive and negative ionospheric storms and large-scale traveling ionospheric disturbances (LSTIDs) over China during the 10–11 October 2024 geomagnetic storm. (a) From the late main phase to the early recovery phase, a low-latitude positive storm coexisted with negative disturbances at higher latitudes, accompanied by enhancement and poleward expansion of the equatorial ionization anomaly (EIA) crest. Around 05:00–06:00 UT, the positive disturbance shifted to midlatitudes, while a negative storm developed at low latitudes. The negative storm was concentrated within 15°-35°N and intensified toward lower latitudes. Within 15°-25°N, the maximum VTEC depletion reached approximately 52 TECU, exceeding 60% of the background value, and the negative storm persisted for about 12.5 h; no sustained negative storm developed within 35°-45°N. COSMIC-2 profiles further revealed a transition from early electron density enhancement to deep depletion, accompanied by an increase in the F2 peak height. Mechanism analysis indicates that nighttime eastward disturbance electric fields and penetration electric fields under undershielding conditions enhanced the fountain effect, while equatorward winds lifted the F layer and reduced plasma loss, jointly producing the positive storm. During daytime, westward disturbance electric fields suppressed plasma supply to the EIA and, together with poleward winds, promoted the development of the negative storm. The absence of widespread O/N₂ depletion suggests that thermospheric compositional change was not the dominant driver of the low-latitude negative storm. (b) Five groups of equatorward-propagating LSTIDs were identified, with phase speeds of 397–662 m/s, periods of 50–64 min, and wavelengths of 1380–2383 km. Their occurrence broadly coincided with enhancements in field-aligned currents and auroral electrojet activity, consistent with excitation by atmospheric gravity waves generated through high-latitude energy and momentum input. These results demonstrate the combined electrodynamic and neutral-atmospheric control of storm-time ionospheric responses and provide observational evidence for magnetosphere-ionosphere-thermosphere coupling over China.

full_list.title_en: From Weighted Frontier d-States to Geometric Descriptors for Atomically Dispersed Catalysts at the Molecule-Solid Crossover
full_list.title_zh: 从加权前沿 d 态到分子-固体交叉原子分散催化剂的几何描述符
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically dispersed catalysts exhibit molecule-solid crossover character when localized metal orbitals hybridize with support-derived bands, a regime not fully captured by either a d-band-center description or a frontier-orbital picture. We establish an electronic-to-geometric framework for oxygen reduction across fourteen metals. N-to-P substitution in M-N4 sites raises theoretical onset potentials in 13 systems, with Rh-N3P reaching 0.88 V, comparable to the Pt(111) benchmark. Scaling relations reduce *OOH, *O, and *OH thermodynamics to ΔG*OH. M-N4 follows a dyz-dominated frontier-orbital picture, whereas M-N3P requires a weighted frontier d-state representation built from adsorption-relevant orbitals and their occupancies. The resulting ϵWFDS correlates with ΔG*OH at R² = 0.92, compared with 0.83 for the d-band center and 0.64 for the frontier-orbital. The identified roles of orbital occupancy and local coordination suggest an interpretable geometric descriptor, ζM-N3P = nd/rM-P, that predicts ΔG*OH at R² = 0.96. The ORR volcano analysis identifies strong-binding systems and motivates axial oxygen coordination. This design raises onset potentials by 0.70-2.46 V, and the M-N3PO descriptor predicts ΔG*OH at R² = 0.91. By bridging frontier-orbital and d-band-center descriptions, the framework provides a physically grounded electronic representation and a geometry-based screening route compatible with machine-learned interatomic potentials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 当局域金属轨道与载体衍生的能带杂化时，原子分散的催化剂表现出分子-固体交叉特征，这种状态不能被 d 能带中心描述或前沿轨道图完全捕获。我们建立了一个电子到几何框架，用于十四种金属的氧还原。 M-N4 位点中的 N 到 P 取代提高了 13 个系统中的理论起始电位，其中 Rh-N3P 达到 0.88 V，与 Pt(111) 基准相当。比例关系将 *OOH、*O 和 *OH 热力学简化为 ΔG*OH。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量, Wannier 插值和有效电子模型，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《从杂化泛函参数化DFT+U+V：一种基于Wannier函数的关联子空间哈密顿量方法》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Uncertainty-quantified J-integral computation for quasicontinuum and finite element methods
full_list.title_zh: 用于准连续介质法和有限元法的量化不确定性J积分计算
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.23003v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The J-integral is a fundamental concept in fracture mechanics, quantifying the energy release rate that drives crack propagation. This work presents a rigorous implementation and validation of the J-integral within the multiscale three-dimensional (3D) quasicontinuum (QC3D) method, along with an uncertainty quantification analysis applicable to both QC3D and conventional FE methods. We compute the 3D J-integral under plane-strain assumptions, utilizing continuum mechanics fields (stress and strain energy density) derived from the underlying interatomic potential through the Cauchy--Born rule. Our implementation is comprehensively validated against both linear elastic fracture mechanics (LEFM) theory and the virtual crack extension (VCE) method for three regimes of increasing complexity: small-strain elasticity, and nonlinear deformation without and with atomic relaxation in the region near the crack tip. Excellent agreement is demonstrated in all cases. Further, we introduce a novel Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) framework to statistically assess the uncertainty in J-integral results for a given mesh and integration domain in QC3D and conventional FE methods. Our implementation's predictive capability is demonstrated through a QC3D simulation of a three-point bending test on silicon, where the computed critical energy release rate is shown to be in excellent agreement with the Griffith criterion. This work establishes a reliable and efficient framework for evaluating crack driving forces in multiscale fracture simulations with quantified uncertainty, enabling large-scale fracture simulations while resolving atomistic mechanisms at the crack tip.
full_list.abstract_zh: J积分是断裂力学中的一个基本概念，用于量化驱动裂纹扩展的能量释放率。本研究在多尺度三维（3D）准连续体（QC3D）方法中严格实施和验证了J积分，并进行了适用于QC3D和传统有限元（FE）方法的不确定性量化分析。我们利用通过柯西-伯恩规则从潜在的原子间势能导出的连续介质力学场（应力和应变能密度），在平面应变假设下计算 3D J 积分。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: J积分是断裂力学中的一个基本概念，用于量化驱动裂纹扩展的能量释放率。本研究在多尺度三维（3D）准连续体（QC3D）方法中严格实施和验证了J积分，并进行了适用于QC3D和传统有限元（FE）方法的不确定性量化分析。我们利用通过柯西-伯恩规则从潜在的原子间势能导出的连续介质力学场（应力和应变能密度），在平面应变假设下计算 3D J 积分。对于三种复杂度递增的模式（小应变弹性以及裂纹尖端附近区域有或无原子弛豫的非线性变形），我们的实现方法均已根据线性弹性断裂力学（LEFM）理论和虚拟裂纹扩展（VCE）方法进行了全面验证。在所有情况下都表现出极佳的一致性。此外，我们还引入了一种新颖的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）框架，用于在QC3D和传统有限元方法中对给定网格和积分域的J积分结果的不确定性进行统计评估。通过对硅进行三点弯曲试验的QC3D模拟，展示了我们实现的预测能力，其中计算出的临界能量释放率与格里菲斯准则非常吻合。这项工作为在多尺度断裂模拟中评估具有量化不确定性的裂纹驱动力建立了一个可靠且高效的框架，从而能够进行大规模断裂模拟，同时解析裂纹尖端的原子机制。
full_list.summary: J积分是断裂力学中的一个基本概念，用于量化驱动裂纹扩展的能量释放率。本研究在多尺度三维（3D）准连续体（QC3D）方法中严格实施和验证了J积分，并进行了适用于QC3D和传统有限元（FE）方法的不确定性量化分析。我们利用通过柯西-伯恩规则从潜在的原子间势能导出的连续介质力学场（应力和应变能密度），在平面应变假设下计算 3D J 积分。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：蒙特卡洛统计采样。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《用于准连续介质法和有限元法的量化不确定性J积分计算》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Compact Slow-Wave Hybrid Magnonics on Ultrahigh-Permittivity Substrates
full_list.title_zh: 超高介电常数衬底上的紧凑型慢波混合磁振子学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid magnonics based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) enables strong, broadband magnon-photon coupling, but the centimeter-scale device footprints required at low gigahertz frequencies hinder integration. Here, we demonstrate miniaturized slow-wave hybrid magnonic devices using an ultrahigh-permittivity ceramic substrate (ε = 140). Owing to the inverse-square-root dependence of the SSPP plasma frequency on effective permittivity, the required corrugation finger length is reduced by nearly a factor of four compared with conventional microwave substrates. The ceramic is thick and brittle, and conventional thin-film processes cannot easily pattern thick, low-loss conductors on it. We overcome this challenge with additively manufactured electronics (AME). In a customized AME workflow, a multi-material inkjet printer first prints a dielectric fixture that holds and registers the ceramic. After the ceramic is loaded, the printer prints thick silver SSPP patterns directly onto it. Measurements on six printed devices with different finger lengths confirm the predicted geometry-frequency scaling. Moreover, the enhanced field confinement of the compact SSPP waveguide nearly doubles the magnon-photon coupling strength and yields ultrastrong coupling with g/fₚ approx 22%. Notably, this performance is achieved using a YIG film whose magnetic volume is more than an order of magnitude smaller than that employed in previous SSPP demonstrations. These results establish AME on ultrahigh-permittivity substrates as a practical route toward compact, strongly coupled hybrid magnonic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于欺骗表面等离子体激元 (SSPP) 的混合磁振子可实现强宽带磁振子-光子耦合，但低千兆赫频率所需的厘米级器件占用空间阻碍了集成。在这里，我们展示了使用超高介电常数陶瓷基板 (ε = 140) 的小型化慢波混合磁振子器件。由于 SSPP 等离子体频率与有效介电常数呈平方根倒数关系，与传统微波基板相比，所需的波纹指长度减少了近四倍。陶瓷又厚又脆，传统的薄膜工艺无法轻松地在其上形成厚的低损耗导体图案。我们通过增材制造电子产品 (AME) 克服了这一挑战。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基于欺骗表面等离子体激元 (SSPP) 的混合磁振子可实现强宽带磁振子-光子耦合，但低千兆赫频率所需的厘米级器件占用空间阻碍了集成。在这里，我们展示了使用超高介电常数陶瓷基板 (ε = 140) 的小型化慢波混合磁振子器件。由于 SSPP 等离子体频率与有效介电常数呈平方根倒数关系，与传统微波基板相比，所需的波纹指长度减少了近四倍。陶瓷又厚又脆，传统的薄膜工艺无法轻松地在其上形成厚的低损耗导体图案。我们通过增材制造电子产品 (AME) 克服了这一挑战。在定制的 AME 工作流程中，多材料喷墨打印机首先打印用于固定和记录陶瓷的介电夹具。装入陶瓷后，打印机会直接在其上打印厚厚的银色 SSPP 图案。在具有不同手指长度的六种印刷设备上进行的测量证实了预测的几何频率缩放。此外，紧凑型 SSPP 波导的增强场限制几乎使磁子-光子耦合强度增加了一倍，并产生 g/fₚ 约 22% 的超强耦合。值得注意的是，这种性能是使用 YIG 薄膜实现的，其磁体积比之前 SSPP 演示中使用的磁体积小一个数量级以上。这些结果将超高介电常数基底上的 AME 确立为实现紧凑、强耦合混合磁振子器件的实用途径。

full_list.title_en: Finite amplitude shape oscillations of magnetic microbubble under uniform magnetic field
full_list.title_zh: 均匀磁场下磁性微泡的有限振幅形状振荡
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study presents a theoretical model for the non-spherical oscillations of a lipid-encapsulated bubble infused with magnetic particles and subjected to a uniform magnetic field. Since the applied magnetic field is uniform, its gradient vanishes, making the existing weakly magnetic membrane theory inapplicable. To overcome this limitation, an alternative formulation that accounts for both the thinness and weak magnetic nature of the bubble shell is developed. Using this formulation, the induced magnetic field is calculated for a spherical bubble and incorporated into a Lagrangian framework for describing the non-spherical oscillations. The resulting governing equations for the radial and shape modes are then derived. The analysis shows that both the natural frequencies and exponential stability of the shape modes increase with increasing applied magnetic field. The frequency response of the shape modes shifts towards higher frequencies as the applied magnetic field is increased, consistent with the increase in their natural frequencies. Furthermore, finite-amplitude oscillations exhibit a period-doubling sequence and progressively transition towards chaotic behaviour with increasing magnetic field strength.
full_list.abstract_zh: 这项研究提出了注入磁性颗粒并受到均匀磁场作用的脂质封装气泡的非球形振荡的理论模型。由于施加的磁场是均匀的，其梯度消失，使得现有的弱磁膜理论不再适用。为了克服这一限制，开发了一种替代公式，该公式可以同时考虑气泡壳的薄度和弱磁性。使用该公式，计算球形气泡的感应磁场，并将其纳入拉格朗日框架中以描述非球形振荡。然后导出径向和形状模式的控制方程。分析表明，形状模式的固有频率和指数稳定性随着施加磁场的增加而增加。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 这项研究提出了注入磁性颗粒并受到均匀磁场作用的脂质封装气泡的非球形振荡的理论模型。由于施加的磁场是均匀的，其梯度消失，使得现有的弱磁膜理论不再适用。为了克服这一限制，开发了一种替代公式，该公式可以同时考虑气泡壳的薄度和弱磁性。使用该公式，计算球形气泡的感应磁场，并将其纳入拉格朗日框架中以描述非球形振荡。然后导出径向和形状模式的控制方程。分析表明，形状模式的固有频率和指数稳定性随着施加磁场的增加而增加。随着施加的磁场增加，形状模式的频率响应向更高频率移动，这与其固有频率的增加一致。此外，有限振幅振荡表现出倍周期序列，并随着磁场强度的增加逐渐过渡到混沌行为。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《均匀磁场下磁性微泡的有限振幅形状振荡》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Tweezing microparticles by tightly focused optical skyrmionic fields
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Tweezing microparticles by tightly focused optical skyrmionic fields
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.32137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The concept of skyrmions, once translated to the optical domain, provides a topological framework to investigate structured light-matter interactions. However, their practical use for the manipulation of material systems remains barely explored. Here, we experimentally demonstrate trapping and tunable orbital motion of dielectric microparticles in tightly focused skyrmionic polarization textures prepared using a compact spin-orbit optical element. We explore the tweezing capabilities at fixed topology either by varying the relative weights of the orthogonally polarized components or by switching between skyrmion and bimeron polarization textures. Vectorial focusing and optical-force calculations qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations. These results motivate extending skyrmionic light to the manipulation of micro-objects, including birefringent and chiral samples.

full_list.title_en: Adding Temperature to the Adiabatic Connection: Hybrid Functionals for Static and Dynamic Correlation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Adding Temperature to the Adiabatic Connection: Hybrid Functionals for Static and Dynamic Correlation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22284v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Capturing static and dynamic electron correlation simultaneously at manageable computational cost remains a key challenge in electronic structure theory. Motivated by the recurring role of effective temperature in self-consistent field methods we extend the adiabatic connection mechanism from density functional theory (DFT) to include a temperature dimension. The formalism unifies established hybrid functionals with information-density matrix functional theory (i-DMFT) and thermally-assisted-occupation DFT, clarifying their theoretical basis and the respective prescriptions for the temperature parameter. It further gives rise to thermally enhanced hybrid functionals, in which static correlation is captured via fractional occupations generated by an effective "correlation temperature" within thermal Hartree-Fock, while dynamic correlation is described by established density functional approximations. We assess the performance of several thermally enhanced hybrids for different cases where i-DMFT was previously shown to fail. Furthermore, we discuss and test different schemes for determining the correlation temperature and investigate the accuracy of different such choices for a benchmark set of different organic molecules. The results clarify the achievable balance of accuracy, generality, and efficiency, establishing thermally enhanced hybrids as a systematic route toward low-cost treatment of both correlation types.

core_items.title_en: Efficient spin-lattice dynamics and spin thermometry with machine-learned magnetic potentials
core_items.title_zh: 利用机器学习的磁势进行高效的自旋晶格动力学和自旋测温
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.32129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In finite-temperature spin-lattice dynamics, conventional force-only spin thermometers fail for energies nonlinear in each spin, while the standard semi-implicit SIB integrator requires two model evaluations per step. Here we introduce a geometric-probe spin temperature that is exact for arbitrary high-order smooth Hamiltonians using first-order spin forces alone without Hessians, making it naturally suited for nonlinear many-body machine-learning (ML) magnetic potentials. Complementarily, our cached-field integrator (CFI) stays second-order accurate with a single model evaluation per step, about halving the time per step with ML potentials. Extensive benchmarks against Monte Carlo across analytic and ML systems confirm both exact thermometry and accurate thermodynamics.
core_items.abstract_zh: 在有限温度自旋晶格动力学中，传统的仅受力自旋温度计因每次自旋中的能量非线性而失效，而标准半隐式 SIB 积分器每步需要两次模型评估。在这里，我们引入了一种几何探针自旋温度，该温度对于仅使用一阶自旋力而不使用 Hessians 的任意高阶平滑哈密顿量来说是精确的，使其自然适合非线性多体机器学习 (ML) 磁势。作为补充，我们的缓存字段积分器 (CFI) 通过每步进行单个模型评估来保持二阶精度，大约可利用 ML 潜力将每步时间减半。

core_items.title_en: Parametric neural-network wavefunctions across a bosonic phase transition
core_items.title_zh: 玻色相变中的参数神经网络波函数
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.33150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose Boseformer, a universal attention-based neural-network architecture for representing the wavefunctions of particles with bosonic quantum statistics, including superfluid and crystal phases. The model is trained to generate the wavefunction as a function of a Hamiltonian parameter across the quantum phase transition between these phases. Once trained with variational Monte Carlo optimization, it can serve as a foundation model describing the phase transition without the need to retrain it for individual parameter values. We demonstrate our method on a system of two-dimensional bosons with 1/r³ repulsive interaction.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 Boseformer，一种基于注意力的通用神经网络架构，用于用玻色量子统计表示粒子的波函数，包括超流体和晶相。该模型经过训练，生成波函数作为这些相之间量子相变的哈密顿参数的函数。一旦使用变分蒙特卡罗优化进行训练，它就可以作为描述相变的基础模型，而无需针对各个参数值对其进行重新训练。我们在具有 1/r3 排斥相互作用的二维玻色子系统上演示了我们的方法。

core_items.title_en: Comparative Molecular Dynamics Study of Initial Oxide Film Growth on Al, Mg, and Ti Using a Universal Neural Network Potential
core_items.title_zh: 使用通用神经网络势对 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上初始氧化膜生长进行比较分子动力学研究
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.32659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spontaneous formation of an oxide film, which may be passive, is found in many metals such as Al and Ti. We report direct computational observation of oxide film formation on the three major light structural metals, Al, Mg, and Ti, with molecular dynamics (MD) using a universal neural network potential (NNP). O2 molecules were supplied during MD simulations to replenish O consumed by the metal. Al and Ti formed a 1-2 nm thick film within a few ps of the simulation with O2 gas pressure of 102-103 atm. The film thicknesses of all metal oxides continued to increase proportionally to the logarithm of simulation time, consistent with Cabrera-Mott theory. Al and Ti oxides grow at the surface, while Mg oxide grows into the Mg metal. Al, Mg, and Ti are approximately 4.4, 4.3, and 5.2-fold coordinated, respectively, in the oxide.
core_items.abstract_zh: 许多金属（例如铝和钛）会自发形成氧化膜，该氧化膜可能是钝化的。我们报告了使用通用神经网络势 (NNP) 通过分子动力学 (MD) 对三种主要轻结构金属 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上氧化膜形成的直接计算观察。在 MD 模拟过程中提供 O2 分子以补充金属消耗的 O2。在氧气压力为 102-103 atm 的情况下，Al 和 Ti 在模拟的几皮秒内形成了 1-2 nm 厚的薄膜。所有金属氧化物的薄膜厚度继续与模拟时间的对数成比例增加，与卡布雷拉-莫特理论一致。

core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《使用通用神经网络势对 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上初始氧化膜生长进行比较分子动力学研究》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: OMNI-P3x universal neural network potential for large-scale computational photochemistry workflows
core_items.title_zh: OMNI-P3x 通用神经网络在大规模计算光化学工作流程中的潜力
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.32133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational photochemistry supports the design and understanding of new materials. However, the high cost of excited-state quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations makes screening large molecular libraries prohibitively expensive. To address this limitation, we introduce OMNI-P3x, a universal machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) for singlet ground- and excited-state simulations of neutral and charged organic molecules. Trained on both ground- and excited-state conformations, it performs complete computational photochemistry workflows with accuracy approaching TD-DFT. We demonstrate its practical applicability by screening a combinatorial library of 234,375 flavylium derivatives, where the pretrained model performs ground-state geometry optimization and predicts absorption properties without additional QM calculations. Following fine-tuning, we further screen 162,960 xanthene-based dyes, identifying new candidates for red, near-infrared and short-wavelength infrared emission. Furthermore, state-dependent neural charges, learned without reference atomic charges, provide an interpretable picture of intramolecular charge redistribution upon excitation.
core_items.abstract_zh: 计算光化学支持新材料的设计和理解。然而，激发态量子力学（QM）计算的高昂成本使得筛选大型分子库的成本过高。为了解决这一限制，我们引入了 OMNI-P3x，这是一种通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)，用于中性和带电有机分子的单线态基态和激发态模拟。它经过基态和激发态构象的训练，可以执行完整的计算光化学工作流程，精度接近 TD-DFT。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Ground state and thermal phase diagrams of the magnetized spin-1/2 XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice
core_items.title_zh: 三角晶格上磁化自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体的基态和热相图
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.31412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice in a magnetic field is a paradigmatic frustrated quantum magnet, yet its ground-state phase diagram at generic anisotropy and its thermal phase structure remain incompletely understood. Here, using infinite density-matrix renormalization group, infinite projected entangled-pair operator, and exponential tensor renormalization group methods, supported by exact diagonalization, we resolve both issues. At zero temperature, we map the phase diagram continuously from the Ising limit to the Heisenberg point and find that the nonclassical Ψ supersolid is a stable phase just below saturation at all anisotropies studied: it borders the one-third-magnetization up-up-down plateau directly in the strongly easy-axis regime and the semiclassical V phase toward the Heisenberg point. In the strongly easy-axis regime, we uncover an intrinsically finite-temperature bond-nematic phase above the zero-temperature plateau--Ψ boundary, in which the three bond directions become spontaneously inequivalent without transverse spin coherence or three-sublattice order. A hard-core-boson mapping reveals its origin: once thermal fluctuations destroy phase coherence, the field-doped holes settle on domain walls of the local up-up-down order, which are stabilized by quantum kink delocalization and aligned by its Z₃ registry. Our results call for reexamining high-field states in triangular-lattice cobaltates such as Na₂BaCo(PO₄)₂ and K₂Co(SeO₃)₂.
core_items.abstract_zh: 磁场中三角晶格上的自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体是典型的受挫量子磁体，但其一般各向异性的基态相图及其热相结构仍未完全了解。在这里，使用无限密度矩阵重整化群、无限投影纠缠对算子和指数张量重整化群方法，在精确对角化的支持下，我们解决了这两个问题。在零温度下，我们连续绘制从伊辛极限到海森堡点的相图，发现非经典 Ψ 超固体在所研究的所有各向异性下都是略低于饱和度的稳定相：它直接与强易轴区域中的三分之一磁化上下平台和朝向海森堡点的半经典 V 相接壤。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 磁场中三角晶格上的自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体是典型的受挫量子磁体，但其一般各向异性的基态相图及其热相结构仍未完全了解。在这里，使用无限密度矩阵重整化群、无限投影纠缠对算子和指数张量重整化群方法，在精确对角化的支持下，我们解决了这两个问题。在零温度下，我们连续绘制从伊辛极限到海森堡点的相图，发现非经典 Ψ 超固体在所研究的所有各向异性下都是略低于饱和度的稳定相：它直接与强易轴区域中的三分之一磁化上下平台和朝向海森堡点的半经典 V 相接壤。在强易轴状态下，我们发现了零温平台-Ψ边界之上的本质上有限温度的键向列相，其中三个键方向自发地变得不等价，没有横向自旋相干性或三亚晶格顺序。硬核玻色子映射揭示了它的起源：一旦热波动破坏了相位相干性，场掺杂空穴就会沉积在局部上下顺序的畴壁上，这些畴壁通过量子扭结离域稳定并通过其 Z₃ 注册表对齐。我们的结果要求重新检查三角晶格钴酸盐（例如 Na2BaCo(PO4)2 和 K2Co(SeO3)2）的高场态。

core_items.title_en: Intrinsic spin accumulation in the magnetic spin Hall effect
core_items.title_zh: 磁自旋霍尔效应中的本征自旋累积
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2509.24719v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The magnetic spin Hall effect is a time-reversal-odd phenomenon in which spin current is induced by the charge current. In the presence of a spin-orbit coupling and/or noncolinear magnetism, however, spin current is not uniquely defined. Instead, we study an intrinsic response of spin to an electric field gradient that describes the spin accumulation at the boundaries of magnetic systems. We derive a generic formula expressed by Bloch wave functions and apply it to a minimal model for representative altermagnets, RuO₂ and MnF₂. Our results show that the intrinsic spin accumulation can be nonzero in magnetic insulators in sharp contrast to the magnetic spin Hall conductivity.
core_items.abstract_zh: 磁自旋霍尔效应是一种时间反转奇数现象，其中充电电流感应自旋电流。然而，在存在自旋轨道耦合和/或非共线磁性的情况下，自旋流并不是唯一定义的。相反，我们研究自旋对电场梯度的固有响应，该电场梯度描述了磁系统边界处的自旋累积。我们推导了一个由布洛赫波函数表示的通用公式，并将其应用于代表性交流磁体 RuO2 和 MnF2 的最小模型。我们的结果表明，磁绝缘体中的本征自旋累积可以是非零的，与磁自旋霍尔电导率形成鲜明对比。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

core_items.title_en: Spin Hamiltonian, magnetic anisotropy and excitation spectrum in altermagnetic α-MnTe from first principles
core_items.title_zh: 第一原理中互磁 α-MnTe 的自旋哈密顿量、磁各向异性和激发谱
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.31548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The hexagonal altermagnet α-MnTe combines a near-room-temperature collinear order with a strongly spin-split electronic structure, yet the microscopic origin of its easy-plane anisotropy, its zone-center magnon gap and its anomalously large magnetostriction have remained unexplained. We derive the complete low-energy magnetic Hamiltonian of α-MnTe from first principles, combining density functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory with a force-theorem evaluation of the full anisotropic intersite exchange, single-ion terms and classical dipolar couplings. The isotropic exchange, including the altermagnetic splitting of the tenth-neighbor coupling, agrees with inelastic neutron scattering data. Contrary to the common single-ion picture, we find that the easy-plane anisotropy and the magnon gap at Γ are governed by classical dipole-dipole interactions, which enhance the zone-center magnon splitting threefold leading to quantitative agreement with experiment, while the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya term is irrelevant despite its size. The same Hamiltonian reproduces the chiral magnon splitting along antinodal directions, mirroring the electronic spin splitting, and quantitatively accounts for the giant magnetovolume coupling of α-MnTe through the volume dependence of superexchange.
core_items.abstract_zh: 六方相变磁体 α-MnTe 将近室温共线有序与强自旋分裂电子结构结合在一起，但其易平面各向异性、区中心磁振子间隙和异常大磁致伸缩的微观起源仍无法解释。我们根据第一原理，结合密度泛函理论和动态平均场理论，以及完全各向异性位点间交换、单离子项和经典偶极耦合的力定理评估，推导了 α-MnTe 的完整低能磁性哈密顿量。各向同性交换，包括第十邻耦合的交磁分裂，与非弹性中子散射数据一致。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 六方相变磁体 α-MnTe 将近室温共线有序与强自旋分裂电子结构结合在一起，但其易平面各向异性、区中心磁振子间隙和异常大磁致伸缩的微观起源仍无法解释。我们根据第一原理，结合密度泛函理论和动态平均场理论，以及完全各向异性位点间交换、单离子项和经典偶极耦合的力定理评估，推导了 α-MnTe 的完整低能磁性哈密顿量。各向同性交换，包括第十邻耦合的交磁分裂，与非弹性中子散射数据一致。与常见的单离子图像相反，我们发现 γ 处的易平面各向异性和磁振子能隙受经典偶极子-偶极子相互作用控制，这将区域中心磁振子分裂增强三倍，从而与实验定量一致，而 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 项尽管其大小却无关紧要。相同的哈密顿量再现了沿波腹方向的手性磁振子分裂，反映了电子自旋分裂，并通过超交换的体积依赖性定量地解释了 α-MnTe 的巨磁体积耦合。
